description: LinkedIn /collect image and Insight Tag requests, including comma-separated partner IDs, page-load fires, optional conversion metadata and the pinned GET transport. Website Actions /wa/ uses a separate compressed protocol and remains uncontracted. Conversions API has its own pack.

params.name: pid
params.description: The Insight producer joins numeric partner IDs with commas. A single partner ID remains valid.
params.fix_hint: Copy the image pixel from the conversion's Sources page so `pid` carries the Partner ID.

params.name: conversionId
params.description: Optional numeric conversion identity. Ordinary Insight page-load and noscript pixels omit it.

params.name: fmt
params.description: Image pixels are generated with `fmt=gif`. LinkedIn's conversion API sample uses `fmt=img`.

params.name: eventId
params.description: It is the per-event deduplication key. LinkedIn documents it on the image URL as eventId when the same conversion is also sent through the Conversions API.
params.fix_hint: Set eventId to the same value the Conversions API event sends as event_id.

params.name: oid
params.description: It is the advertiser-defined order ID. LinkedIn documents oid on the image pixel for Path to Conversion, so impressions and clicks within 90 days can be joined to the conversion.
params.fix_hint: Set oid to the order ID you want Path to Conversion to attribute, or drop the pair when you are not using that feature.

params.name: url
params.description: It is the conversion match URL. LinkedIn documents url as a URL-encoded page address used when conversionId is absent. The referrer is used when both are missing.
params.fix_hint: Set url to the URL-encoded page you want to match, or drop the pair when conversionId is present.

params.name: time
params.description: Producer time in Unix milliseconds. No freshness window is inferred.

params.name: type
params.description: Conversion types forwarded by the pinned producer.
